set.body:
Outcome: reproducible consumer-facing evidence for the three additions, with engineering, real-backend execution and scientific validity reported separately.
Integration: each implementation owns its catalogue schema, dependency extra, API exports and focused tests. Final pass validates direct calls, named recipe outputs, FeatureBundle.temporal_payload and storage with heterogeneous native grids and nondefault clock mappings. Extend docs/cookbook/music-feature-tiers.qmd with explicit resampling, local asset preparation, code/checkpoint pinning, context semantics and downstream pooling boundary. Update CHANGELOG.md. Preserve existing R public-feature parity; these additions do not promise a new R API.
Required existing repository gates, in configured project environment:
  python scripts/validate_tier_a_stimuli.py
  python scripts/release_check.py --no-r-compare
  python -m pytest -q tests/unit
  python -m pytest -q -m smoke
  make -C docs quarto
Focused proposed tests: python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_music_temporal_contract.py tests/unit/test_mert_contracts.py tests/unit/test_beat_this_contracts.py tests/unit/test_music_structure.py, plus a new tests/integration/test_music_feature_workflow.py.
Optional real-model gate: add tests/external/test_real_music_backends.py following existing environment-selected local-model convention; run python -m pytest -q tests/external/test_real_music_backends.py with explicitly supplied pinned assets. Record dependency versions, asset digests, device, input digests, selected layers, frame timing/counts and direct-upstream parity. A skip is missing evidence, not a pass.
Genre study: choose licensed material and documented annotation/reference conventions, freeze evaluation clips and criteria before inspection, keep tuning material separate, stratify by genre, and include short excerpts/silence. Retain per-clip failure diagnostics. For beat accuracy use independent annotations and declared matching tolerance; no calibration claims without a calibration study. For structure establish specified motif/tonal-change behavior and scope limits; do not equate it with validated phrase labels.
Close individual engineering work only on its tests; record any missing native/scientific qualification explicitly. Implementation-ready is distinct from ready for neural interpretation.
Risks/decision points: external asset availability, compatible backend versions, licensed evaluation data and meaningful cross-genre criteria. No large model download, benchmark, publication or GitHub change has been performed by this planning task.
Suggested execution order: shared contracts -> MERT -> Beat This -> chord profiles -> tonal novelty -> recurrence -> integrated qualification. After the contract, feature implementations are technically independent; avoid concurrent writers to catalogue/dependency files.
Next action: begin shared-contract issue and reserve its exact paths when implementation is requested.
set.title: Music issues #9-11: integrate catalogue/docs and qualify real-model behavior
